_purpose: Phase 0 model registry: pinned model IDs, per-1M-token USD prices, endpoints, and provider discount windows. Prices verified against official provider pricing pages on pin_date. Primary cost analysis uses pinned_price (standard daytime price at freeze, time-invariant); actual paid price after off-peak discounts is recorded per run in the ledger as a sensitivity variable (see DESIGN-DECISIONS D21).
status: PARTIAL: eastern families + judges + designer + fallback pinned and endpoint-verified; gpt/claude/gemini pending API keys

surge_window.peak_multiplier: 2x (press reports, July 2026); official pricing page lists base prices only - VERIFY on billing before any peak-hour run
surge_window.rule: never run during peak windows; base price applies off-peak

execution_window.rule: All experiment runs execute inside the preferred window unless a provider is window-free (kimi, together, western providers flat-priced).
execution_window.rationale: Single window that simultaneously (a) hits the Qwen off-peak discount window and (b) fully avoids both DeepSeek peak-surge windows. Kimi/Together are time-invariant so unaffected.
execution_window.ledger_requirement: every run records started_at_utc, in_discount_window (bool), pinned_price_usd and paid_price_usd estimates; primary T-EGR uses pinned prices, paid prices feed the sensitivity analysis (D21)
